section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used to assess body appreciation (BAS-2), social physique anxiety, life satisfaction, and demographics in an adolescent sample. BMI was computed from self-reported height and weight, and participants were classified into BMI categories using Brazilian-specific cut-off values. The section does not provide sample size, mean values, or correlation results.
